laws.rule: Calabria forest rules prohibit setting up tents and camping in vehicles on forest, pasture and undisturbed land except in prepared camping areas or with express territorial-service authorisation. Agricultural, forestry, emergency and certain access exceptions apply. Park rules may also apply.
laws.heading: Prescrizioni di massima e polizia forestale, articles 15 and 16

laws.rule: Calabria forest rules prohibit off-road vehicles outside permanent roads and parking vehicles on forest, pasture and undisturbed land without express territorial-service authorisation, subject to specified agricultural, forestry, emergency and property-access exceptions. Park rules may also apply.
laws.heading: Prescrizioni di massima e polizia forestale, articles 15 and 16

laws.rule: Calabria forest rules generally ban outdoor fires in woodland or within 50 metres, increasing to 100 metres during the maximum-danger period, subject to the regional fire plan and specified exceptions. During maximum danger they also prohibit fires on beaches and adjoining dunes or rocky strips. Check the current regional fire plan.
laws.heading: Prescrizioni di massima e polizia forestale, articles 15 and 16

laws.rule: Calabria requires an appropriate named regional card or permit to collect wild above-ground mushrooms; the regional government lists a tourist mushroom permit among the available types. Confirm the conditions and allowed land with the authority.
laws.heading: Calabria: funghi e tartufi

laws.rule: In Calabria, searching for and collecting truffles requires the relevant qualification and identification card issued by Calabria Verde.
